description: Get one episode by id. Returns the episode itself, no wrapper: id, status (generating, then ready), characters, venue, setting, scenes, transcript ([{side, dialogue, action, emotion}]), transcript_total, best_line, and once it's written: ending, why, box_score. While status is generating those three are left out (nobody sees them until it's written). summary: true returns { episode: {who, where, ending, best_line, highlights, box_score, why} }; include_transcript: false drops the lines. Owning one of its characters shows the creator view. A date on the show's model takes 1 to 5 minutes to write: wait_seconds (up to 50) waits for it instead of polling; mid-write the reply says how many lines are in. Free.

include_transcript.description: false leaves the lines out (a much smaller reply): the ending, box score and transcript_total stay. Default true.

since_turn.description: Only the transcript from this line on (0-based; transcript_total says how many there are), for polling a date being written.

summary.description: true: just the result: who, where, the ending, the best line, the box score and why.

wait_seconds.description: While it's still being written, wait up to this long for it (default 0: answer now).

name: get_episode
title: Read an episode
